name: apoapostolov-pi-wsl
description: Pi on Windows runs bash through Git Bash, which rewrites /mnt/c, \\wsl.localhost, and $VARS before WSL sees them. pi-wsl spawn()s System32\wsl.exe so Linux commands arrive intact. Use the wsl tool or /wsl. Repairs eaten UNC paths, maps Git Bash /c/foo, and lists installed distros on Win11 + WSL2.
